question: From what distance does the seventh circle exert its influence on observers?
premises: The effect relates to that circle
The practitioner is devoted to worship and meditation
inference: Even a distant sight of one devoted to this circle’s worship and meditation carries its power.
uncertainties: Whether darśanaṃ means seeing the practitioner or the vision granted is ambiguous
plain_english: Indeed, for one devoted to its worship and meditation, its vision has effect even from afar.
